Third-party files used by OCR (loaded only when a PDF or photo is read):
- tesseract.js 5.1.1 (Apache-2.0), tesseract.js-core 5.1.1 (Apache-2.0), eng.traineddata (tessdata_best_int, Apache-2.0): in-browser OCR
- pdf.js (pdfjs-dist 3.11.174, Apache-2.0): reads PDFs and draws scanned pages
Nothing is sent to any server: the reading happens in the browser.
